items.title: Danaher (DHR) Could Be 8% Below Fair Value Following Its Dividend Reaffirmation
items.summary: Danaher (DHR) has reaffirmed its shareholder payout, with the Board approving a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share, payable on October 30, 2026, to holders of record on September 30. The reaffirmed dividend lands at a time when Danaher’s short-term momentum has picked up. The 90-day share price return is 17.78% and the 1-year total shareholder return is 10.73%, even though the 5-year total shareholder return is down 25.46%. items.title: Should You Buy Donaldson Stock While Its Share Count Stops Shrinking?
items.summary: Donaldson (DCI) has gained 9.1% over the past twelve months and still trades about 20% below its 52-week high. The filtration company behind those numbers sells replacement parts into equipment already in service, and the cash from that stream has been steadily shrinking its share count. The shrinking count is the case for buying the pullback. It is also the part that goes quiet in fiscal 2027.
